idea-plugin.name: Agents Usage
idea-plugin.description:
Agents Usage

Monitor Codex, JetBrains AI, and GitHub Copilot usage directly in IntelliJ Platform IDEs, including IntelliJ IDEA and Rider. Maintained by Lars Nörber.

  • Displays remaining 5-hour and weekly quotas in the status bar.
  • Displays remaining JetBrains AI subscription and top-up credits when AI Assistant is installed.
  • Displays GitHub Copilot usage when the Copilot plugin is installed.
  • Displays each provider's subscription plan and compact colored usage bars.
  • Provides a compact Tool Window with reset times and progress indicators.
  • Supports manual refresh and configurable automatic refresh intervals.
  • Automatically discovers the local Codex CLI from the system PATH.

Requirement: Codex CLI must be installed and signed in on the local machine.

This plugin reads usage locally through Codex CLI. It does not upload usage data. Codex is a trademark of OpenAI; this independent plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
